description: Teres major is the thick border of the posterior axilla, sweeping from the scapula to the humerus to pull the arm back and inward with powerful grace.
actions: Adducts the humerus, drawing the arm close to the torso in strong pulling motions.
Extends the shoulder from a flexed position, powering rowing and climbing gestures.
Medially rotates the humerus, turning the inner arm forward for expressive poses.
